entry.name: pictctrl
entry.description: Creating buttons, switches, knobs, and other controls using images from a picture file for its appearance.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Toggles mouse control of theobject. The default is 1 (enabled). If a separate set of inactive images is present in theobject's picture file and if the inactive images attribute is set, themessage will also change the appearance of the control.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: clickedimage
attributes.description: Toggles the use of an alternate set of image frames in your picture file to give the dial a different appearance when the user clicks on it and drags the mouse pointer.disables this feature.

attributes.name: clickincrement
attributes.description: Sets the output value to increment by 1 each time the object is clicked (Click to Increment mode). Any movement of the mouse after clicking is ignored. When the uppermost value is reached, the value returns to zero with the next click. All other mouse tracking modes are disabled.disables Click to Increment mode.

attributes.name: clip
attributes.description: Causes pictctrl, while in dial-mode, to clip mouse-movement within the range of the dial. When followed by a 0,will wrap around to the minimum when it surpasses the maximum value (within the range of the dial) and vice versa to the maximum when it surpasses the minimum value.

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: degrees
attributes.description: Specifies the degree-of-rotationhas while in dial-mode.

attributes.name: fontface
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontsize
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: frames
attributes.description: Specifies the number of images (columns) in the picture file. The number of frames does not have to be the same as the range of the control; theobject will use the nearest image for any given value.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hint
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: imagemask
attributes.description: When non-zero, indicates that your picture file has an image mask. The default is 0 (no image mask). Enablingenables checking for transparent parts of an image. If theattribute is set to a value greater than zero and less than one, mouse clicks on transport portions of an image will be ignored by.

attributes.name: inactiveimage
attributes.description: When non-zero, indicates that your picture file has an additional row of images for its inactive state. The default is 0 (no inactive state).

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Selects mode of operation for theobject.(the default)

attributes.name: multiplier
attributes.description: Sets a multiplier value. Whenis in dial mode, the object's value is multiplied by this number before being sent out the outlet. The multiplication happens before the addition of the Offset value. The default multiplier value is 1.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Designates the graphics file that theobject will use will use for the control's button or dial file. By convention, theobject uses images saved in Portable Network Graphics (.png) format. If you are using Max on Windows and want to to work with images other than PNG or PICT files, we recommend that you install QuickTime and choose a complete install of all optional components. The symbol used as a filename must either be the name of a file in Max's current search path, or an absolute pathname for the file (e.g. "").

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: Sets an offset value. Whenis in dial mode, the offset value is added to the object's value before being sent out the outlet. The default offset value is 0.

attributes.name: param_connect
attributes.description: Establishes a two-way connection between the object and a parameter of a compatible object with parameters such asor. The object can be used to change the value of the parameter and will update if the parameter value changes. The easiest way to setis with the attribute's menu in theor the Connect submenu of the. The menu displays all available parameters of compatible objects.Setting theattribute with a message requires the target parameter's path, which is the host object's scriping name followed by two colons and the parameter name. For example, for aobject with scripting name, the path of theparameter would be. You can set a value for thebefore the host object or parameter exists, and the object will connect to the parameter once it exists. Refer to the user guide entry forfor more details.

attributes.name: parameter_enable
attributes.description: Enables use of this object withandin Max.

attributes.name: parameter_mappable
attributes.description: When parameter_mappable is enabled, the object will be available for mapping to keyboard or MIDI input using the.

attributes.name: patching_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: position
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: range
attributes.description: Sets the range of theobject when it is in dial mode. The default value is 128.

attributes.name: ratio
attributes.description: Specifies how many pixels the mouse pointer must move before the value of the dial changes by one increment. If theobject is using Circular Tracking, the ratio message specifies how many degrees the cursor must move, relative to the center of the object, to increase the value by one.

attributes.name: rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: snap
attributes.description: Setsto snap to the image's original size. When followed by a 0,will not snap to the image's original size.

attributes.name: textcolor
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: textjustification
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: threshold
attributes.description: Theattribute is the alpha value above which an image pixel's alpha value needs to exceed for a mouse click to register. This permits using an image with transparency where the transparent portion of the image will not register mouse clicks. In order for this attribute to have any effect it should be set to a value greater than zero but less than one (0.5 is a suggested value). Settingto a higher value permits ignoring semi-transparent portions of an image. To ignore clicks on transparent parts of an image, you will also need to use a PNG format image file and tell theobject your image has transparency by enabling theattribute.

attributes.name: trackcircular
attributes.description: Sets theobject to respond when you click on it and drag the mouse in a circular arc relative to the control's center (Circular Tracking mode). Moving the mouse clockwise increases the control's value, and moving it counterclockwise decreases its value. Enabling circular tracking disables all other tracking modes.disables circular tracking.

attributes.name: trackhorizontal
attributes.description: Sets theobject to respond when you click on it and drag the mouse horizontally; moving the mouse to the right increases the object's value, and moving it to the left decreases the value. Enabling this mode of operation disables the Circular Tracking and Click to Increment modes (see theandmessages).

attributes.name: tracking
attributes.description: Toggles live tracking. If live tracking is on, theobject will change its state if the mouse moves in and out of the rectangular border of the object with the mouse button held down.disables live tracking

attributes.name: trackvertical
attributes.description: Sets theobject to respond when you click on it and drag the mouse vertically; moving the mouse up increases the object's value, and moving it down decreases the value. Enabling this mode of operation disables the Circular Tracking and Click to Increment modes (see theandmessages).

attributes.name: varname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

messages.name: (drag)
messages.description: When a image file is dragged from the Max File Browser to aobject, the image will be loaded.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: Clicking on theobject and dragging sends the current value out the outlet. Additional behaviors depend on how the object is configured using messages or setting attributes using the Inspector.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Sends the current value of theto the outlet.

messages.name: int
messages.description: Sets the value of the button or knob set by the control, and sends the current value out the outlet. In button and toggle mode, the value must be either 0 or 1. In dial mode, the range of values is determined byobject's Range attribute.

messages.name: link
messages.description: The word, followed by a filename to a file which has already been loaded into theobject will link the object with that file.

messages.name: picture
messages.digest: Read an image file from disk
messages.description: The wordfollowed by the name of an image file will read that file into theobject. The word with no name following opens a standard file dialog for choosing an image file.

messages.name: read
messages.digest: Read an image file from disk
messages.description: The wordfollowed by the name of an image file will read that file into theobject. The word with no name following opens a standard file dialog for choosing an image file.

messages.name: readany
messages.digest: Read any file as an image
messages.description: The wordfollowed by the name of a file will read any type of file into theobject and attempt to interpret it as a picture.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set current value with no output
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the value of the button or knob to that number, without triggering output.

inlets.digest: int (0-1) Sets Value, read Opens File
